g.text: Lab 04: Complete Unified API Layer Architecture
Capstone Integrated Topology: Nginx Edge Gateway • OpenAPI 3 Validation • Redis Idempotency Mutex • Zero DB Replays
Step-by-step trace of how mutations, retry replays, and multi-layered rejections flow through the integrated platform
• Nginx verifies key & forwards both headers
• Acquires lock: SET idemp:<key> "IN_PROGRESS" EX 60 NX
• Saves payload in Redis (24-hr TTL EX 86400)
Edge defense, contract verification, atomic locking, and
persistence succeed in a single coordinated transaction.
Gateway passes key directly to api_service
Retrying through public gateway produces identical semantics
while completely bypassing backend database operations.
Each tier rejects its specific failure mode at the earliest
possible boundary, protecting deep application layers.
